# DeaconGuard development

DeaconGuard is a Go CLI and web UI that scans the Linux machine it runs on and, in server mode, machines running `deaconguard agent`, which enroll with a one-time token and connect out to the server over pinned HTTPS (`internal/agentapi`, `internal/agent`, `internal/server/agents.go`). SSH scanning was removed before 0.1.0; hosts from older databases are kept for their history but cannot be scanned. The server evaluates agents' packages itself and never trusts package verdicts from an agent. Commands run on the scanned machine are fixed, read-only strings (package inventory reads in `internal/target`, optional checks in `internal/checks`) and go through the `target.Target` interface, implemented by `internal/local`. They may run through `sudo` only when the host allows it. Never persist credentials, and never report a failed or incomplete scan as clean.

`deaconguard serve` hosts a loopback-only React UI from `web/` (embedded via `web/embed.go`) over the JSON API in `internal/server`; hosts and scans live in SQLite via `internal/store`. Build with `make build` (or `go build ./cmd/deaconguard` without the UI); run `go test ./...` and `go vet ./...`. Only enable a platform when its official advisory source and evaluator are verified. Unsupported advisory rules must be reported, never counted as clean.
